body: Review afea0709..265dcd07 (265dcd0739bda95b42f4a3c0368ca32f1049ac8f). internal/tasks/intent/load_tree_test.go:131-139 compares only final errors. Installed Tasks build.202 lacks checkpoint strings and its 2026-09-29 tag predates checkpoint commit 5802f353; this supports current runtime age only. Related existing V1-1051 remains OPEN.
